# Mentor To Marry Full Site Summary

Mentor To Marry, also called MTM, is a guided path for Christian singles preparing for intentional marriage. The site serves serious Christian singles in Nigeria, the diaspora, and global communities who want mentoring, review, accountability, and responsible matching before moving toward introductions.

## Core Positioning

MTM begins with counsel before connection. The goal is not endless swiping or casual dating. The journey starts with mentoring so singles can slow down, clarify values, build maturity, and prepare for the responsibility of marriage.

## Mentoring First

MTM includes eight weeks of mentoring classes. The mentoring journey helps singles examine readiness, faith, values, communication, and the realities of covenant marriage. Assessments and guided reflection help members understand strengths, areas for growth, and the kind of support they need next.

## Matching And Accountability

After preparation and review, members may browse eligible profiles, receive recommendations, use structured chats, and move toward introductions according to their membership level and readiness stage. MTM prioritizes responsible recommendations over forced outcomes.

## Coaches And Founders

Mentor To Marry is guided by Kingsley and Mildred Okonkwo. The program brings pastoral care, practical wisdom, and a standard of trust to the marriage preparation journey.

## Pricing

Regular is a yearly membership for singles beginning the MTM mentoring and matching journey with structure and accountability. It includes eight weeks of mentoring classes, assessments and surveys, limited profile browsing, accountability, weekly chats, country-based matching, and weekly chat carryover.

Premium is a yearly membership for singles who want broader access, richer mentoring resources, and stronger recommendation support. It includes everything in Regular, monthly profile recommendations, unlimited profile browsing, priority access to coaches, access to global pool and profiles, more weekly chats, chat carryover, and private groups.

VIP is a yearly membership for singles who want the most personal level of mentoring, protection, and introduction support. It includes everything in Premium, a dedicated matchmaker and coach, priority access to PK and PM, unlimited profile browsing, off-platform introductions, MTM Profile Shield, and access to global profiles.

## Free Singles Community

MTM also offers a free singles community for Christian singles who want to learn, connect, receive teachings, and stay close to the MTM journey until they are ready for guided membership. The community includes free teachings, conversations, updates, events, and next steps into MTM.

## FAQ

MTM is different from a dating app because it is built around mentoring, readiness, accountability, review, and responsible matching.

Mentoring comes before matching because recommendations work better when members have been guided, reviewed, and helped to understand what they are ready for.

Members complete onboarding and assessments, then their profile and readiness signals are reviewed before recommendations are made.

Membership includes access to the MTM preparation flow, mentoring-led guidance, assessments, review, and eligibility for recommendations based on plan and readiness stage.

Membership does not guarantee a match, mutual interest, or marriage.

Diaspora and global Christian singles can join.
